'''Zone Three''' was a district of [[Gallisport]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shesharile 5]]. It was an abandoned industrial zone with low-cost residential units. It was the location of [[Ta's Roost]] and [[Chop's Shop]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Rabid Mynocks]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] protected Zone Three.
